name: orangebot-ai
title: Orangebot AI
description: A complete AI assistant chat front-end with no backend required. Zepa-branded website-builder assistant: sidebar with new chat, auto-created projects and profile; an orange bot avatar that rotates through five GIFs (no two neighbours match); streaming replies with markdown, template cards, section cards, plan cards and a design-call card; a contained booking modal with day and time slots; and a glowing composer with Attach, Deep Think and Send.
